query:
-- Deletar lançamentos contábeis dos journals
DELETE FROM accountingEntries WHERE journalId IN (
  SELECT journalId FROM journalSources 
  WHERE sourceType = 'expense' 
  AND sourceId = (SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE docNumber = '07202603437463826')
);

-- Deletar journal sources
DELETE FROM journalSources 
WHERE sourceType = 'expense' 
AND sourceId = (SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE docNumber = '07202603437463826');

-- Deletar journals órfãos
DELETE FROM journals WHERE id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT j.id FROM journals j
  LEFT JOIN journalSources js ON j.id = js.journalId
  WHERE js.id IS NULL
)
